summary: Iteration 35 - Parcel creation bug fix & help-popup UX. Backend: 6/6 tests passed for POST/GET /api/parcels (minimal payload, full payload, 422 for missing name, unauthorized rejected, list). Frontend: BLOCKED - farmer demo user is redirected to an 'Abonnement requis' (trial expired) subscription gate when navigating to /parcelles, so the parcelles-page, help popup, inline errors, and success flow could NOT be exercised via UI. Additionally, a critical React 'Maximum update depth exceeded' infinite re-render loop floods the console on /parcelles (hundreds of identical errors).

minor.issue: Empty-string name is accepted by backend (no min_length constraint on Pydantic model). Frontend validates min 3 chars but backend should also enforce to prevent API misuse.

ui_bugs.issue: Farmer demo user (agriculteur@agricam.ai) hits 'Abonnement requis' subscription gate when visiting /parcelles. Trial expired message: 'Votre periode d essai de 14 jours est terminee'. The parcelles-page test-id is never rendered, blocking all UX validation of the new help popup and inline errors.

Console floods with 'Maximum update depth exceeded. This can happen when a component calls setState inside useEffect, but useEffect either doesn't have a dependency array, or one of the dependencies changes on every render.' — hundreds of repeats. Likely in GuidedTour, SubscriptionGate, or a useEffect that sets state on every render. This would likely cause severe performance issues for end users.
Untranslated keys visible: NAV.GROUPANALYSIS, NAV.GROUPFIELD, NAV.GROUPFLEET, NAV.GROUPMARKET, NAV.GROUPLEARNING, nav.farmMap
